definitions.geometry: Actual released ray is projected to the keeper body depth observed at release, and horizontal separation is measured there. Intended committed target is projected separately to remove placement spread. This is a release snapshot, not later moving-body/catch geometry and not a capture-radius acceptance quota.
definitions.context: Pressure at most0.2 and independent opportunityQuality0.65 are descriptive diagnostic cuts. Categories and actual execution remain unchanged. Saved and goal subgroups are retained separately.
definitions.baseline: Earlier pilots lack committed target/keeper fact metadata; their release execution geometry remains available where recorded. Missing fields are unavailable rather than inferred from a future result.
